primary_mission: Continuously develop the highest achievable genuinely accurate 24h and 7d crypto BUY / SELL / WAIT signals with positive after-cost expectancy.

policy.hourly_self_improvement_question: What should be added, removed, simplified, combined, deprioritized, or tested next to improve genuine after-cost signal accuracy, profitability and reliability while reducing overfitting, duplicated research and wasted compute?
policy.hourly_self_improvement_policy: Re-evaluate this question at each hourly eligibility check using available evidence, but do not force a paid model call, bypass the 12-hour successful-run cooldown, exceed the $1/day API budget, raise physical concurrency, or change production authority merely to answer it.

data-market.mission: Apply UNIVERSAL_SIGNAL_DEVELOPMENT_V1 by spending scarce API budget only on the highest expected signal-quality or information-gain work. At every eligibility review explicitly ask what should be added, removed, simplified, combined, deprioritized, or tested next to improve genuine after-cost accuracy, profitability and reliability, and use that answer only to prioritize safe research. Prioritize diagnosis of genuine resolved 24h/7d errors, timestamp-safe predictive data, selective WAIT/meta-label evidence, economic calibration, regime-strategy routing, cross-sectional/residual signals, prospective execution/microstructure vetoes, ensemble diversity, and falsifiable hypotheses. Deprioritize blind indicator parameter permutations, redundant strategies, duplicate disproven hypotheses, extra logical-worker expansion without evidence, and repeated ACC-002 investigation while failures remain pure InsufficientHistory. Prefer deterministic Python, cached/reused evidence, and cheap rejection before model calls. Do not spend API budget merely to stay busy. Do not weaken the 0.80/two-subset ACC-002 gate, chronology, untouched OOS, multiple-testing, point-in-time safety, cost realism, or promotion controls.
